<h1 id="U2b8z"></h1>
<h2 id="kLxa6"><span class="ne-text">一、文件系统基础命令</span></h2>
<h3 id="lPpF1"><span class="ne-text">1.1 相对路径 &amp; 绝对路径</span></h3>
<table id="Jnnlb" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u5cf9712e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">类型</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u31c3d294" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">定义</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u6021f31e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">示例</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u0f71dbea" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">绝对路径</span></strong></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u4875acdd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">以根</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/</span></code></p>
<p id="u8bb658b8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">开头的路径，在任何位置都可使用</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="ub806fc66" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/passwd</span></code></p>
<p id="u37bfa5fb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">、</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/root/name</span></code></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u236a0d6d" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">相对路径</span></strong></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u73eb1eb7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">不以根开头，相对于当前所在目录</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u93b20e0a" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">passwd</span></code><span class="ne-text">（当前目录下的文件）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p id="udd639c1e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">bash</span></p>
<pre id="QfzLw" class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>[root@lab ~]# ls passwd        # 在当前目录下找 passwd，不存在则报错
ls: cannot access 'passwd': No such file or directory

[root@lab ~]# ls /etc/passwd   # 绝对路径，成功
/etc/passwd</code></pre>
<h3 id="t5CVq"><span class="ne-text">1.2 文件命名规则</span></h3>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u93ee0135" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">文件名</span><strong><span class="ne-text">区分大小写</span></strong></li>
<li id="udada3f14" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">同目录下不能存在同名文件</span></li>
<li id="uaa252d32" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">文件名长度≤255字符</span></li>
<li id="ua7dd9532" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">尽量不用特殊字符：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">? $ % ^ &amp; *</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 等</span></li>
</ol>
<h3 id="EEsl0"><span class="ne-text">1.3 touch 命令</span></h3>
<p id="ud73c4324" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">作用</span></strong></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="uf50fbf08" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">创建</span><strong><span class="ne-text">空文件</span></strong></li>
<li id="uc9b43918" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">更新已有文件</span><strong><span class="ne-text">时间戳</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<p id="u9a173576" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">用法</span></strong></p>
<pre id="ypQcu" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>touch 文件名          # 当前目录创建
touch /opt/xym       # 指定路径创建</code></pre>
<p id="u2f5ec78c" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">文件3个时间戳</span></strong></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u5b2f42df" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Access Time：最后</span><strong><span class="ne-text">访问</span></strong><span class="ne-text">时间</span></li>
<li id="u20faf0a6" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Modify Time：文件</span><strong><span class="ne-text">内容</span></strong><span class="ne-text">最后修改时间</span></li>
<li id="u9ca05f70" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Change Time：文件</span><strong><span class="ne-text">属性</span></strong><span class="ne-text">（权限、大小、名称）最后修改时间</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="udc75d158" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">查看时间戳</span></strong></p>
<pre id="OA0f6" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>stat 文件路径</code></pre>
<p id="u518991a1" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="888" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779883000300-56378a3d-ab03-4450-b6e7-f184bf41a179.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp"></p>
<p id="u3e3847d5" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">总结</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：文件不存在则创建，存在则更新时间戳。</span></p>
<p id="ue3de69c5" class="ne-p"></p>
<h3 id="kGaAF"><span class="ne-text">1.4 mkdir 创建目录</span></h3>
<pre id="muB3e" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>mkdir 目录路径                # 创建单层目录
mkdir -p /opt/a/b/c/d/e/f/g  # -p 递归创建多级父目录</code></pre>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u9c8c5f88" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-p</span></code><span class="ne-text">：父目录不存在自动创建，无报错</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="Fucwe"><span class="ne-text">1.5 rm 删除文件/目录</span></h3>
<pre id="gfksn" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>rm 文件名            # 删除文件，交互式询问
rm -f 文件名         # -f 强制删除，不询问
rm -r 目录名         # -r 递归删除目录及内容
rm -rf 目录名        # 强制递归删除目录（常用）</code></pre>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u56e6bbb3" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">rm</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 是 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">rm -i</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 别名，默认删除会询问</span></li>
<li id="u3ae83a13" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">rm -rf</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 谨慎使用，不可逆</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="aZX2k"><span class="ne-text">1.6 rmdir 删除空目录</span></h3>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ua0c8382c" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">仅能删除空目录</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，非空目录无法删除</span></li>
</ul>
<pre id="RD2ff" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>rmdir 空目录名</code></pre>
<h3 id="paXUW"><span class="ne-text">1.7 ls 列出目录内容</span></h3>
<h4 id="tS7kY"><span class="ne-text">常用参数</span></h4>
<table id="uBQBL" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u85308528" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">参数</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u4ef1c58a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">作用</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u7135b687" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-l</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u352875d2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">显示</span><strong><span class="ne-text">详细属性信息</span></strong></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="ucb27b273" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-a</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ue7ecc1ed" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">显示</span><strong><span class="ne-text">隐藏文件</span></strong><span class="ne-text">（以 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">.</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 开头）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="uf361f8b3" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-h</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u5257b575" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">人性化显示文件大小（配合 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-l</span></code><span class="ne-text">）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u886fe5ae" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-R</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u66fab70f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">递归列出所有子目录内容</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="udcbbba13" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-t</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u247c563f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">按修改时间倒序排序</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u90743e8b" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-r</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u94cc4b6b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">排序取反</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="uf055549d" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-d</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u493681bd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">只查看目录本身属性</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u10afa2ea" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">--color=auto</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u4abf7d47" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">按文件类型显示颜色</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u5b4f3866" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ll</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 是 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ls -l --color=auto</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 别名</span></li>
</ul>
<h4 id="ghoFA"><span class="ne-text">alias 查看系统的命名别名</span></h4>
<p id="u4abacd5f" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="258" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779883949202-a62cf566-cac3-4f0a-8468-8c102ab944c2.png"></p>
<h4 id="ddOUb"><span class="ne-text">ls -l 字段详解</span></h4>
<p id="ub6e720e7" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-rw-r--r--. 1 root root 2192 May 16 16:46 /etc/passwd</span></code></p>
<p id="u51d02e31" class="ne-p"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u38f947f1" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">文件类型</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u0ff95fb7" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-</span></code><span class="ne-text">：普通文件</span></li>
<li id="ub5aa200f" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">d</span></code><span class="ne-text">：目录</span></li>
<li id="ue0d62d98" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">b</span></code><span class="ne-text">：块设备（硬盘/光驱）</span></li>
<li id="u4b3b33dd" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">c</span></code><span class="ne-text">：字符设备（键盘/鼠标）</span></li>
<li id="u4a995eaa" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">l</span></code><span class="ne-text">：软链接（快捷方式）</span></li>
<li id="u011c1810" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">s</span></code><span class="ne-text">：套接字文件</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="2">
<li id="uc41098cd" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">权限</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：属主、属组、其他人 rwx（读写执行） 权限</span></li>
<li id="uba837cb2" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">末尾 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">.</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 表示文件受 SELinux 安全机制保护</span></li>
<li id="udcdf8186" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">硬链接数</span></li>
<li id="u4c4985dc" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">属主、属组 </span></li>
<li id="u06968f59" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">文件大小（字节）</span></li>
<li id="u16eca1b9" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">修改时间</span></li>
<li id="u5f575ec8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">文件名</span></li>
</ol>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="u72074088" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Linux 后缀无系统识别意义，仅给人看。</span></p>
</div>
<h3 id="mwlqD"><span class="ne-text">1.8 cd 切换目录</span></h3>
<pre id="W4HK4" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>cd           # 回到当前用户家目录
cd ~         # 回到家目录
cd ~用户名   # 进入指定用户家目录
cd ..        # 回到上一级目录
cd -         # 切换到上一次所在目录
cd 路径      # 切换到指定路径</code></pre>
<h3 id="RQV46"><span class="ne-text">1.9 pwd 命令</span></h3>
<pre id="buuyz" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>pwd  # 打印当前所在工作目录</code></pre>
<p id="u22eb2634" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="228.66666666666666" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779939790895-1ca5ca21-96c9-497e-b1d7-c7934b245fd4.png"></p>
<h3 id="QYIv0"><span class="ne-text">1.10 file 命令</span></h3>
<p id="u3d4577c5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">专门</span><strong><span class="ne-text">查看文件真实类型</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，不受后缀影响。</span></p>
<pre id="emSQZ" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>file 文件名</code></pre>
<p id="u76ef6026" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="218.66666666666666" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779939945208-4af9c885-da3a-4f1b-9f47-6c21a0d275a6.png"></p>
<p id="ucf1749bb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">empty表示 空文件</span></p>
<h3 id="jIFpL"><span class="ne-text">1.11 cp 拷贝命令</span></h3>
<p id="uafe14dfe" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">语法</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">cp 源路径 目标路径</span></code></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u5bd6131e" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">拷贝文件</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<pre id="UH8Mk" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>cp /etc/passwd /opt/          # 备份文件到目录
cp /etc/shadow /tmp/shadow-$(date +%F)  # 按时间命名备份</code></pre>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="2">
<li id="u31812cb3" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">拷贝目录</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<pre id="Ub2sd" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>cp -r /etc /tmp    # -r 递归拷贝目录
cp -a /etc /tmp    # -a 归档拷贝，保留权限、时间戳、软链接所有属性</code></pre>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u8e7ee700" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-a</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 等同于 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-dR --preserve=all</span></code></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="GH9Ux"><span class="ne-text">1.12 mv 移动/重命名</span></h3>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="uc5a1bd99" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">同目录</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：mv = </span><strong><span class="ne-text">重命名</span></strong></li>
<li id="u24f3c4b6" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">不同目录</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：mv = </span><strong><span class="ne-text">移动文件/目录</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<pre id="sGkaa" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>mv 原文件名 新文件名       # 重命名
mv 文件/目录 目标路径      # 移动</code></pre>
<h2 id="nhITW"><span class="ne-text">二、用户与用户组管理</span></h2>
<h3 id="os7zw"><span class="ne-text">2.1 Linux 用户分类</span></h3>
<table id="KD5xy" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="uc056aa25" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">用户类型</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="ue5d57097" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">UID 范围</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="uec54a6ac" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">说明</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u6c2e2cbf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">超级管理员</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u1c804ba7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">UID=0</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u909d01e1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">root，拥有系统最高权限</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u6296bd38" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">系统用户</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u33410dab" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">0&lt;UID&lt;1000</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u8f066b0f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">运行系统服务，</span><strong><span class="ne-text">禁止登录</span></strong></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u99f188ed" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">普通用户</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="uf6dad59d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">UID≥1000</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="ucb8e6483" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">管理员创建，供日常登录使用</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="neqo7"><span class="ne-text">2.2 用户信息配置文件 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/passwd</span></code><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="332" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779940807806-0b1c2111-5e7c-4c9e-a89f-b9527426197c.png"></h3>
<p id="uc5584654" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">每行格式：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">用户名:x:UID:GID:描述:家目录:登录Shell</span></code><span class="ne-text"><br></span><span class="ne-text">字段说明：</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u72ab72c7" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">用户名</span></li>
<li id="ub12e45e9" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">密码占位符 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">x</span></code><span class="ne-text">（真实密码存 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/shadow</span></code><span class="ne-text">）</span></li>
<li id="ubbc14552" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">UID 用户ID</span></li>
<li id="u5971909c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">GID 组ID</span></li>
<li id="ud9686173" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">备注描述</span></li>
<li id="u39495168" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">用户家目录</span></li>
<li id="u2c444ed6" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">登录Shell</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="u607f9f5a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text"> 常见的两类：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ud497dfe3" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/bin/bash</span></code><span class="ne-text">：可登录系统</span></li>
<li id="uda0f50eb" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/sbin/nologin</span></code><span class="ne-text">：禁止登录</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<p id="udada33c0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">sync:x:5:0:sync:/sbin:/bin/sync</span></p>
<p id="u3fe714b9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">shutdown:x:6:0:shutdown:/sbin:/sbin/shutdown</span></p>
<p id="u8a9c0895" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">halt:x:7:0:halt:/sbin:/sbin/halt</span></p>
<p id="u4ad27765" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">比较特殊的登录</span><span class="ne-text">SHELL</span></p>
<p id="u71f52ae7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">/bin/sync其实就是sync命令，而sync命令就是将内存中的数据刷入到磁盘中（赶紧把缓存数据写到磁盘里面）</span></p>
<p id="uce836c1f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">/sbin/shutdown 和 /sbin/halt 作用一样：关机</span></p>

<p id="u9a5e33b3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">用户组的密码文件/etc/gshadow</span></p>

<h4 id="LMAcs"><span class="ne-text">useradd 创建用户</span></h4>
<p id="u6e522594" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">常用参数</span></p>
<table id="LWoHJ" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u1c197d14" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">参数</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u8fe6f423" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">作用</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u9e63a6a8" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-u</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ub6569cd6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">指定UID</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="udde80216" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-g</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u65e2be8f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">指定私有组GID</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u08a2cc4e" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-G</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ud263b071" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">指定附加组（会覆盖原有的附加组新增用-aG）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u80f327e7" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-c</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u02d81e5b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">添加描述信息</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u4ebe37df" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-d</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u52f2df26" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">指定家目录</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u168a0e99" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-s</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ude9df35c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">指定登录Shell</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u519e3003" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-M</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u7dd38c06" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">不自动创建家目录</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p id="ubc4071f1" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">UID 分配原则</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：未手动指定时，系统分配</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/passwd</span></code> <span class="ne-text">中最大 UID + 1。</span></p>
<p id="ud078f050" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">默认行为</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u25f2a3bb" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">家目录：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/home/用户名</span></code></li>
<li id="ub7d68c34" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">邮箱文件：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/var/spool/mail/用户名</span></code></li>
<li id="ue728ca7b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">创建同名的私有组</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u2e7f013a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p id="u1d5bb0bc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">示例</span></p>
<p id="u24397921" class="ne-p"></p>
<pre id="IWffS" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>useradd mengxin                  # 创建普通用户
useradd -u 2026 -c "game user" memeda01
useradd -s /sbin/nologin mysqluser  # 不可登录用户</code></pre>
<p id="ua5f1f50d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">需求一：创建</span><span class="ne-text">memeda01用户，要求UID是2026，要求描述信息是game user</span></p>
<pre id="lEQLk" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>useradd -u 2026 -c “game user” memeda01</code></pre>
<p id="u35e15089" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">需求二：创建</span><span class="ne-text">mysqluser用户，描述信息database user，不可以登录系统</span></p>
<pre id="uJUCi" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>useradd -c “database user” -s /sbin/nologin mysqluser</code></pre>
<p id="uf3b83788" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">需求三：创建</span><span class="ne-text">caiwu用户，私有组就是caiwu，附加组是mysqluser</span></p>
<pre id="YsW1C" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>useradd -G mysqluser caiwu</code></pre>
<p id="uf85ecbea" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">需求四：创建</span><span class="ne-text">diruser用户，用户的家目录在/tmp/diruser</span></p>
<pre id="KDLCj" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>useradd -d /tmp/diruser diruesr</code></pre>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="ud5d83e4b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">不指定UID系统找最多的UID+1分配</span></p>
<p id="ub9ae63d6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">创建用户会同时创建一个同名的邮箱和组</span></p>
<p id="ud8f8cb0b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">用户必须要有一个组</span></p>
<p id="u200fba34" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">附加组：用户可以加入到其他组</span></p>
</div>
<h4 id="kHVGI"><span class="ne-text">passwd 设置用户密码</span></h4>
<pre id="AHuOU" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>passwd 用户名</code></pre>
<h4 id="VPldx"><span class="ne-text">usermod 修改用户属性</span></h4>
<table id="vyXjD" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u3e4854da" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">选项</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ub1263f33" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">说明</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="uae24907a" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-G 组名</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ua484f289" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改附加组（会覆盖原有附加组）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u3e245c92" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-aG 组名</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u6e1d824f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">新增附加组（不覆盖）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u9f01d4ba" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-d 路径</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u7e26c7b8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改家目录（只改配置文件，不创建目录）</span></p>
</td>

<tr>

</td>

<p id="ufbfdcc3d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改登录 SHELL</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="ud185a008" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-L</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u6a35b327" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">锁定用户</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u6078a09f" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">-U</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u8dd06fa3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">解锁用户</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre id="lLRU6" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>usermod -s /sbin/nologin 用户名   # 禁止登录
usermod -aG 组名 用户名           # 追加附加组（-aG 不覆盖原有组）</code></pre>
<h4 id="J7pzs"><span class="ne-text">userdel 删除用户</span></h4>
<pre id="Ibg8n" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>userdel 用户名        # 只删用户，保留家目录、邮件
userdel -r 用户名     # -r 彻底删除：用户+家目录+邮件</code></pre>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="uf4d3f23a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">首先你创建一个用户</span><span class="ne-text">user110，系统分配的UID假设是1000</span></p>
<p id="u28bbecf3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">现在你通过</span><span class="ne-text">userdel删除user110用户，但是家目录和邮件文件不会删除</span></p>
<p id="uead763c8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">家目录和邮件文件</span><span class="ne-text">UID和GID就是1000</span></p>
<p id="u0676ebf4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">此时你通过</span><span class="ne-text">useradd user111的用户---&gt;UID 1000</span></p>
<p id="u51ecd71a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">user111用户继承了1000的UID</span></p>
<p id="u1843b660" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">此时家目录和邮件文件</span><span class="ne-text">UID和GID就是1000 就被user111可以访问了</span></p>
<p id="ub181fcb0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这个时候，文件就没有私密可言了</span></p>
</div>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="u6d6bfe98" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">老用户</span><span class="ne-text">abcuser</span></p>
<p id="u6cd5e652" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">家目录和邮件文件没有删除</span></p>
<p id="u54f6911a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">再创建一个用户</span><span class="ne-text">abcuser</span></p>
<p id="u6c2a6555" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">此时删除</span><span class="ne-text">abcuser用户，这些目录和邮件文件会删除</span></p>
</div>
<p id="u0c18cbcf" class="ne-p"></p>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="u762ee9e0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">老用户</span><span class="ne-text">abcuser</span></p>
<p id="u95cba232" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">家目录和邮件文件没有删除</span></p>
<p id="u58d3a848" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">再创建一个用户</span><span class="ne-text">123user</span></p>
<p id="u846146d2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">此时删除</span><span class="ne-text">123user，老的目录和邮件文件不会删除</span></p>
<p id="u214de4aa" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">userdel 删除用户的时候，删除的是同名的目录和邮件</span></p>
<p id="uaffddef1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">/home/123user 可以被删除</span></p>
<p id="u1c1de756" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">/home/abcuser</span></p>
</div>
<p id="ud69c2296" class="ne-p"></p>
<h3 id="ZuLti"><span class="ne-text">2.4 用户组配置文件 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/group</span></code></h3>
<p id="u86e4c794" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">格式：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">组名:x:GID:组内成员</span></code></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u479468c1" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">记录组名、密码占位符、GID、组内附加成员</span></li>
<li id="u509b35ef" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">私有组成员不会在此文件显示</span></li>
</ul>
<table id="rFyfY" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="ua9177e0d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">字段</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ue57a7d64" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">说明</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u90067d8c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第1列</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="uce222fbb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">组名</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="ub0860469" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第2列</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u847a723e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">组的密码占位符</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="uadec7e20" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第3列</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u93d3738d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">GID</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u5113dda3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第4列</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="uccdd4e93" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">组内成员（私有组的成员不显示）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="iOGmv"><span class="ne-text">2.5 用户组管理命令</span></h3>
<table id="wBk0J" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u21e637b2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">命令</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u1d7d8efa" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">作用</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="ue36b1696" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupadd</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u30d08b4f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">创建组</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u47348111" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupmod</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u95872767" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改组</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="ud422660f" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupdel</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="ued436280" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">删除组</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="udf309a26" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">gpasswd</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="uba157d43" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">设置组密码、管理组成员</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u5c51a78e" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupmems</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u2721bae9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">列出/添加/删除组成员</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre id="f3iG6" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>groupadd -g 3333 itgroup   # 创建指定GID组
groupdel 组名              # 删除组（不能删用户私有组）
gpasswd 组名               # 设置组密码、管理组成员
newgrp 组名                # 登录组
groupmems                  # 查看/添加/移除组成员</code></pre>
<h4 id="db2f39dc"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupadd</span></code> <span class="ne-text">– 创建组</span></h4>
<p id="u73304294" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">bash</span></p>
<pre id="cYdL9" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>groupadd -g 3333 itgroup               # 指定 GID 创建组</code></pre>
<h4 id="7ed4052c"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupmod</span></code> <span class="ne-text">– 修改组</span></h4>
<p id="u9a28f4c8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">bash</span></p>
<pre id="oTDeB" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>groupmod -n newname oldname            # 重命名组</code></pre>
<h4 id="56c108c7"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupdel</span></code> <span class="ne-text">– 删除组</span></h4>
<p id="ufbbd55dc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">bash</span></p>
<pre id="JrD4f" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>groupdel itgroup                       # 若某用户的私有组是该组，则无法删除</code></pre>
<h4 id="617a4d01"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">gpasswd</span></code> <span class="ne-text">– 管理组密码和成员</span></h4>
<p id="u9a67129f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">bash</span></p>
<pre id="fQG5b" class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>gpasswd 组名                           # 设置组密码
gpasswd -a user 组名                   # 添加用户到组
gpasswd -d user 组名                   # 从组中删除用户
gpasswd -A user 组名                   # 设置组管理员</code></pre>
<h4 id="3c5fd66f"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">groupmems</span></code> <span class="ne-text">– 管理组成员</span></h4>
<p id="u890028da" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">bash</span></p>
<pre id="JF3Ul" class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>groupmems -g 组名 -l                   # 列出组成员
groupmems -g 组名 -a user              # 添加用户
groupmems -g 组名 -d user              # 删除用户</code></pre>
<p id="u34edd818" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">也可用 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">usermod -aG</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 添加附加组。</span></p>
<p id="ua657fd2a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">记忆：</span></p>
<p id="u8c0bbb9c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">加用户到组：usermod</span></p>
<p id="udd334b34" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">删除组的用户：gpasswd</span></p>
<p id="ub1f220c8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">列出组的成员：groupmens</span></p>
<h3 id="IIbMW"><span class="ne-text">2.6 密码影子文件 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/shadow</span></code></h3>
<p id="u629dab20" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">仅root可读取，存放</span><strong><span class="ne-text">加密用户密码</span></strong><span class="ne-text">及密码策略</span></p>
<pre id="SFpFf" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>mengxin:$6$pfNug4M3ru8qFDpN$0pNQj/37TvTCJzadBGXWXC4ljl6hAyBIwFevxLU.BQuAVzPiS6UuIzikk9.J7QCwF2gmbx5/6uYuEmsH96yn21:20596:0:99999:7:::</code></pre>
<table id="ORJBV" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="375">
<p id="u74bb5cd0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">字段</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">
<p id="u79f27b7c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">说明</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>

</td>

</td>
</tr>

</td>

</tr>

</td>
</tr>

<td width="375">
<p id="u69853791" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第6列</span></p>
</td>
<td width="375">

</table>
<p id="ua3035359" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">加密算法标识</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ufca94be8" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">$6$</span></code> <span class="ne-text">→ SHA-512（默认）</span></li>
<li id="u74bdcd1d" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">$5$</span></code> <span class="ne-text">→ SHA-256</span></li>
<li id="u1b978288" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">$1$</span></code><span class="ne-text"> → MD5</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="uee7bbc2c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">用户组的密码文件/etc/gshadow</span></p>
</div>
<p id="uf9c66b43" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">生成加密密码（不通过 passwd）：</span></p>
<pre id="Qmi2q" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>
openssl passwd -6 123                  # 输出 SHA-512 加密的密文
# 然后手动替换 /etc/shadow 对应行</code></pre>
<h3 id="XqkZ5"><span class="ne-text">2.7 chage 密码策略管理</span></h3>
<p id="u39c9ad4d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看和修改用户密码策略：</span></p>
<pre id="qHIQ9" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>chage -l 用户名          # 查看密码策略
chage -m 30 -M 90 -W 20 -E 2027-12-01 用户名  # 修改策略
chage -d 0 用户名        # 强制下次登录改密码</code></pre>
<h3 id="AV0bZ"><span class="ne-text">2.8 默认密码策略配置</span></h3>
<p id="u0be0911d" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/login.defs</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 定义新建用户默认规则：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ub08d5233" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">PASS_MAX_DAYS</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 密码最大有效期</span></li>
<li id="u27729bdc" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">PASS_MIN_DAYS</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 密码最小间隔天数</span></li>
<li id="u7649e13d" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">PASS_WARN_AGE</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 过期提前告警天数</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="rBLSI"></h2>
